# AI crawler policy (decided 2 Oct 2026; the owner may change it).
# MMC wants to be found and cited by search engines and AI assistants, so everything public is open to everyone,
# including the crawlers that train models (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot). To opt out of training only,
# move those four to "Disallow: /" and leave the search and user-triggered agents below allowed.
# Search and answer agents, named so the decision is explicit and easy to audit:
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/

# Training crawlers: allowed by default for brand visibility.
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/

Sitemap: https://www.mondaymarketing.company/sitemap-index.xml
